### Vengeance on Amalek
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/vengeance-on-amalek
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:1-9
Points:
- God instructed Saul to execute divine judgment upon the Amalekites for their past ambush of Israel.
- Saul showed mercy to the Kenites because of their historical kindness toward God's people.
- Saul compromised the Lord's clear command by sparing King Agag and keeping the valuable livestock.
- Partial obedience is fundamentally disobedience that exposes an unfaithful heart before God.
- While the Lord shows great patience, His patience eventually comes to an end for those who rebel.

### Rationalizations
Author: Charles Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-26-2024.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 15:9-11
Points:
- Saul broke God's direct command by keeping everything desirable while destroying only what was worthless.
- Instead of showing shame or repentance, Saul sought to justify his actions and honor himself.
- Finishing well through consistent faithfulness is far more important than a promising start.
- Rationalization is an insidious form of disobedience that twists reality to excuse sin.
- Self-deception begins quietly but can blind anyone to how foolish their behavior has become.
